Body.Content:
Updated November 25, 2026: We have updated the content. Thank you for your patience. 

What and Why:

Creating a video from a text prompt in Microsoft Clipchamp has moved. It's now in Clipchamp Home, the start page of the Clipchamp app, instead of Copilot Create and the 'Generate a video' option in the Clipchamp editor. The upgraded experience will be available to the same users as part of their existing subscription.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): Now: creating a video from a prompt is available in Clipchamp Home.

By the end of February 2027: the upgraded experience replaces the current one. We'll publish an update to this post with confirmed dates.

Impact on Your Organization:

To create a video from a prompt, users go to m365.cloud.microsoft, open the app launcher, select More apps, select Clipchamp, and then use the prompt box at the top of Clipchamp Home. Step-by-step instructions: How to create video with Copilot.

When the upgraded experience arrives, users get the same capabilities with better video quality.

Existing content stays where it is. Video projects and exported MP4 files remain in users' OneDrive or SharePoint, and users can keep opening, editing and exporting them in Clipchamp.

All other Clipchamp features and admin settings stay the same.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No admin action is needed. You might want to share the support article above and tell users that video creation from a prompt is now in Clipchamp Home, and update any internal training or help content to match.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Value: Video creation from a prompt in Microsoft Clipchamp has moved to Clipchamp Home with an upgraded experience coming by February 2027. Users access it via the Microsoft 365 app launcher. Existing projects remain accessible, no admin action is needed, and all other features stay unchanged.

Title: Video creation from a prompt in Microsoft Clipchamp: now in Video Hub, with an upgraded experience coming
